description: Opens a merge request (GitHub pull request) with the uncommitted changes of a repository in an allowed folder with write access, e.g. core_dump: formats the changed C/C++ files, creates a new branch, commits all changes, pushes it and opens the pull request into the default branch, then waits for the merge gate and returns the quiz link. Use it only when the change is complete and clean: make builds with no errors or warnings, make check passes, and doxy reports no documentation problems. Never commit, branch or merge with git yourself; this tool does it. With action sync it instead updates the repository's default branch from GitHub: do that before starting work, so you work on the latest code. It never merges a pull request; a person reviews it.

params.name: path
params.description: The repository folder, starting with an allowed folder name, e.g. core_dump

params.name: action
params.description: open (default): open a merge request; sync: update the default branch from GitHub

params.name: title
params.description: Required to open a merge request: what the change does, e.g. Add an e module that prints Euler's number

params.name: body
params.description: Description for the reviewer: what changed, why, and how it was checked (e.g. make builds without warnings)

params.name: branch
params.description: Branch name to create; omit it to derive one from the title (agent/...)
